findings.title: Remaining work (c) cites DecoderAgreement for the Server's receiving handle, but both sides route by the same function
findings.response: Guide, Remaining work (publication and binding paragraph): identifying the Server's receiving handle needs no contract, because PqxdhRecordLiftProtocol.serverStep routes a raw receive with the same route that receivingHandle reads; DecoderAgreement is a premise of OriginStatement only (not of BindingStatement), relates route to the sender that codec.frameRead decodes, and the plan does not assume that either bound needs it. The takeover plan's world section says the same.

findings.title: FreshGuess plan says 'a sum over the claimed index' without the weighting that keeps the bound at 2^-min
findings.response: Guide, Remaining work (LorStatement and FreshGuessStatement paragraph): for each i, given the adversary's view (so its claimed index and guess) and that the i-th fresh message went to a hidden handle, that message is uniform over its length_i >= min bytes, so Pr[claimed index = i, message i on a hidden handle and equal to the guess] <= Pr[claimed index = i] * 256^-min, and the sum over i is at most 256^-min <= 2^-min; the paragraph notes that bounding each index term by 2^-min alone would give the number of fresh messages times 2^-min. The takeover plan's world section states the weighted form too.
